identify: The photo model matched this to a leafhopper.
Green leafhoppers spread virus diseases of rice.

thresholds.etl: Cotton: More than 2 leaf hopper per leaf and appearance of crinkling and curling of few leaves in the lower portion of plant + marginal yellowing of leaves.

cultural: Plant early and do not plant at the time of peak leafhopper activity.
Transplant older seedlings. They are less open to virus disease.
biological: Protect natural enemies in the field.
